# Sample .npmrc consumed by guroku v0.4's parser.
# See docs/npmrc.md for what each line means.

; Default registry
registry=https://registry.npmjs.org

; Override for the @acme scope (corp internal)
@acme:registry=https://npm.acme.internal

; Auth token for the corp registry (read but unused in v0.4 — v0.5 wires it up)
//npm.acme.internal/:_authToken=hunter2-redacted

; Things guroku v0.4 does NOT yet honour (logged at debug):
strict-ssl=true
save-exact=true
